name: Lark Rise to Candleford
description: Set in the small hamlet of Lark Rise and the wealthier neighbouring market town, Candleford, the series chronicles the daily lives of farm-workers, craftsmen and gentry at the end of the 19th Century. Lark Rise to Candleford is a love letter to a vanished corner of rural England and a heart-warming drama series teeming with wit, wisdom and romance.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Laura Timmins moves from her home in Lark Rise to Candleford, where not everyone is ready to welcome her in.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Laura is getting settled when Mrs Macey's husband finds a way out of prison which becomes hot gossip in town. Caroline has to go to court and possibly debtor's prison, something Laura's father is trying to avoid.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Widow Old Amos announces that he has decided to get married again to his maid Patty. His friends are worried that she is just marrying him for his money. Robert manages to upset his family and the residents of the village when he refuses to let his children sing a song in praise of the Tories at the local church concert.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mr Ashlow arrives in Candleford looking for his estranged daughters, Ruby and Pearl Pratt. Can they forgive him for deserting them when they needed him most? Caroline hides from a bailiff.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dorcas looks after the inspector after he gets injured and he soon realises his evaluation of her may have been wrong. Elsewhere, Emma is annoyed with Robert's kindhearted gesture.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After Robert does a charitable act taking in a family, he ends up caring for a young child. Zillah and Lady Adelaide end up wanting to become foster parents which makes life harder for Sir Timothy. Elsewhere, Thomas becomes unsettled when his devotion for Miss Ellison goes unanswered.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sam Braby is under the influence of alcohol and attacks his wife which makes Emma take it upon herself to help him quit. Elsewhere, the bond between Dorcas and Sir Timothy is starting to get on Lady Adelaide's nerves.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Candleford plays host to a new school headmaster who brings new opportunities for the residents, but also brings their old culture back to life. Sir Timothy is not pleased though as Dorcas has taken a liking to the new guy.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Caroline is back to prove she's a changed woman after her stint in jail, Dorcas is stumped over a piece of embroidery, and Edmund is hurt whilst poaching. Has karma come back to get him?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Phil gets argumentative with Laura's family after Laura confronts him, Dorcas is thinking about leaving Candleford, and Caroline doesn't want to go through her baby's birth alone.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Lark Rise and Candleford prepare for Christmas, a beguiling stranger arrives.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: James Dowland arrives in town, aiming to put Candleford on the map with his new hotel.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dorcas Lane sets out to defeat the dashing James Dowland in the parish council elections.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The death of Miss Ellison's father unites the communities of Lark Rise and Candleford.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Baby Annie Timmins stirs up emotions of days gone by and loves yet to be found.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Everybody rallies around to show support for Laura's new role in the post office.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A clock inauguration brings much anticipation, but sadness looms for the Timmins family.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The hot summer brings a surprise visitor to Candleford, but Dorcas' mind is elsewhere.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Young love brings together the feuding communities of Lark Rise and Fordlow.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Patterson's wife is struck with illness, and gives him permission to seek a new wife.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A storm reveals a secret romance, but also makes the address on a letter indecipherable.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Dorcas welcomes a hospitalised James' son into the post office, causing turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Emma is set to inherit a fortune, enough to move the Timmins to a big house in Candleford.

videos.title: Episode 3

videos.title: Episode 4

videos.title: Episode 5

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A talented seamstress arrives in Candleford and strikes up an instant bond with Pearl.

videos.title: Episode 9

videos.overview: When Mrs Mullins discovers Emily is pregnant, she assumes that Daniel is the father.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mischief Night approaches and people are planning tricks to play on their neighbours. Laura is not in the mood - Fisher Bloom has returned, intent on winning her back.

videos.overview: Dorcas is faced with the heartbreaking prospect of losing her home and denying Sydney his dream of running the post office one day. And Laura is torn between the love of two men.
